text:
maria: seeing intermittent DNS failures from gpu-pool -> services in eu-west. pods get "temporary failure in name resolution" when calling external endpoints. started ~10:12 UTC
joel: any pattern? node, AZ, or after deploys?
taylor: same here, was debugging model download jobs, they open a ton of outbound connections. could be NAT port exhaustion? :thinking_face:
maria: nodes are all in same ASG (gpu-prod-eu-01). hostnames resolve locally sometimes, then fail for a minute, then come back. kubedns logs show a lot of UDP retransmits.
alex: can you paste /etc/resolv.conf from an affected pod? also a quick `dig` output if available.
maria: sure

maria: ```
# /etc/resolv.conf (pod)
nameserver 169.254.20.10
search default.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
options ndots:5
```

maria: dig +short google.com @169.254.20.10 -> nothing sometimes, `dig +tcp` works more reliably.
joel: TCP working but UDP failing is a classic NAT egress port or conntrack prob. what does conntrack look like on the node?
taylor: ran `sudo conntrack -S` on node, here's snippet:

maria: ```
conntrack: NAT entries 65535
conntrack: EXPECT 0
conntrack: found 65532 entries
```

alex: 65535 looks like close to nf_conntrack_max. if conntrack table full it will drop new NAT mappings causing UDP replies to be dropped. DNS over UDP fails.
joel: how many ephemeral ports are we using? check `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range` and `cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_conntrack_max`?
maria: ip_local_port_range: `32768 60999`
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max: `65536`

joel: gpu nodes run a lot of short-lived outgoing flows (model pulls, telemetry, chunked uploads). combined with default conntrack size -> exhaustion.
taylor: short-term mitigation: widen `ip_local_port_range` and increase `nf_conntrack_max`. also enable conntrack hashing by setting `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_time_wait` lower? not ideal.

alex: we can patch nodeset with a sysctl DaemonSet to update values, or use node pool userdata to permanently bump. but immediate fix: rotate the NAT gateway? may free up entries, but better to free conntrack and restart calico/node.
maria: trying `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` on one node now. will also `echo 262144 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max` for persistence during test.

deploy-bot: rolling-restart: initiated restart of kube-proxy on node gpu-prod-eu-01 (job 4872)

maria: after bump, connection failures reduced. dig UDP success rate improved from ~30% to ~95% in our quick sample.
joel: follow-ups: 1) make sysctl change cluster-wide via a DaemonSet and nodeClass update for gpu pools; 2) investigate why model download jobs open many concurrent ephemeral ports — serialize downloads or reuse connections; 3) consider local egress NAT per-AZ to reduce single gateway pressure; 4) add conntrack metrics / alert when usage > 70%.
taylor: also add DNS over TCP fallback for critical services? kube-dns supports it but will increase latency. maybe enable `ndots` tuning and increase caching TTL at node-local-dns.
alex: opened infra ticket INFRA-1219 to track: increase conntrack, add alert, and evaluate egress architecture. I'll schedule a kernel-parameter rollout for gpu pool.
sre-bot: incident annotated: INFRA-1219 created by alex at 2026-04-11T10:40:00Z

maria: thanks all — keeping an eye, will update ticket with measurements and patch diffs. :white_check_mark:
